affected_component: workspace_bundle.validate_workspace details (+_validate_html resource detail) → product_jobs REFERENCE_CONTRACT_FAILED diagnostics, preflight CONTRACT_MISMATCH detail, CONTRACT_FAILED/SMOKE_STRUCTURE_INVALID diagnostics
invariant: Every structural reason code returned by validate_workspace carries one public detail row naming the path it concerns and the rules or resource involved (RULE_OVERLAP: path + both patterns; EXTRA_FILE_FORBIDDEN: the extra paths; REQUIRED_ENTRY_MISSING/CARDINALITY: the pattern and counts; ENTRYPOINT/EXECUTABLE: the path; format failures: path + profile + parser detail such as the external URL). Candidate generation forwards those rows as the diagnostics of WORKSPACE_REFERENCE_CONTRACT_FAILED so a contract or reference repair can act on the exact path instead of re-reading the whole contract; a clean workspace has no rows. No candidate bytes or answer content appear in a row, only paths, patterns and parser-level facts.
